name: Sympathetic Spell (Metamagic)
body:
Cast spells from a distance with a fresh piece of the creature.

Benefit(s): You can alter a spell to target a single creature at any range if you have a fresh piece of the creature in question (such as a strand of hair or drop of blood taken in the last 24 hours). If the spell normally requires touching the target, they are automatically considered touched, but still receive their normal spell resistance and saving throws.

Regardless of other effects of the spell, the target attempts a Fortitude save with a DC set by the base spell. If the target succeeds, they are immune to your further sympathetic spells for 24 hours.

A sympathetic spell uses up a spell slot two levels higher than the spell’s actual level.
